text:
The next time you’re outdoors, go on a 3-digit number hunt. You can find them in all sorts of places: on buildings, buses, signposts… the list is endless!

When you spot one, see if you can say another 3-digit number that’s easy to add to it mentally, and then find the total.

Are there any 3-digit numbers you see on your travels that are difficult to add another 3-digit number to mentally?
